outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open in frame 0 (image, left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door and raises it toward the oven through frames 76–138 (image, left_ego_image). By frame 144 the door is upright against the oven front, and it remains closed through frame 275 (left_ego_image, with the door also visible in wrist_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
